selection_pipeline.operation: scene/variant ID indexes bank-$12 pointer table; the selected six-byte actor records are decoded
record byte 0 high six bits become actor type in $0395,X
actor type indexes the frame-base table, direction/step offset is added, result is written to $0150,X
$0150 frame ID directly indexes descriptor/tile A/tile B and emits four OAM entries
